query:
SELECT a.storage_key, a.access_scope
FROM n_media_assets a
JOIN n_users owner ON owner.user_id = a.owner_user_id
JOIN n_users viewer ON viewer.user_id = :viewer_id
WHERE a.media_id = :media_id
  AND a.status = 'ready'
  AND a.access_scope IN ('chat', 'post')
  AND owner.is_active = 1 AND owner.status = 'active'
  AND viewer.is_active = 1 AND viewer.status = 'active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
    WHERE (b.user_id = viewer.user_id AND b.target_user_id = owner.user_id)
       OR (b.user_id = owner.user_id AND b.target_user_id = viewer.user_id)
  )
  AND (
    (owner.user_id = viewer.user_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm WHERE cm.media_id = a.media_id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm WHERE pm.media_id = a.media_id))
    OR (a.access_scope = 'chat' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm
      JOIN n_chat_messages m ON m.message_id = cm.message_id AND m.author_id = owner.user_id
      JOIN n_chat_channels c ON c.channel_id = m.channel_id AND c.group_id = m.group_id
      JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id = c.group_id
      JOIN n_group_members gm ON gm.group_id = g.group_id AND gm.user_id = viewer.user_id
      WHERE cm.media_id = a.media_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0
        AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0
        AND gm.status IN ('active', 'muted')
        AND (c.is_private = 0 OR gm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'moderator'))
    ))
    OR (a.access_scope = 'post' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm
      JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = pm.post_id AND p.author_id = owner.user_id
      WHERE pm.media_id = a.media_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
        AND p.visibility IN ('private', 'followers', 'mentioned')
        AND fn_can_view_post(viewer.user_id, p.post_id) = 1
    ))
  )
